## berth system service

berth serve as a service of yours: at login, without starting it by hand

### Synopsis

Installs `berth serve` (the API, docs/api.md) as a service of your user: a systemd user unit on
Linux, a launchd agent on macOS. It starts now and at each login, restarts if it stops, and runs
berth through the path you ran this as, so an upgrade keeps it working.

With it running, `berth --via-daemon` and MCP over HTTP have a server to talk to, and so does a
berth elsewhere that has this machine as a registered host.

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_system_service/

### Examples

```
  berth system service install
  berth system service status
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for service
```

```
      --home string              state root (default: $BERTH_HOME, then home: in config.yaml, then ~/.local/share/berth)
      --output string            output format for commands that return data: text or json (docs/json.md) (default "text")
      --read-only                refuse any command that would change state
      --via-daemon berth serve   run the command through a running berth serve, over its socket (docs/api.md)
```
